title: China's imports in August miss estimates as exports pick up pace amid calls for rebalancing trade
summary: China's export and import activity accelerated in August, signaling economic momentum for the world's second-largest economy. However, imports fell short of analyst expectations, highlighting persistent trade imbalances. The data reflects ongoing international pressure for China to rebalance its trade relationships.
content: China's exports and imports gathered momentum in August, as the world's second-largest economy faces mounting pressure to rebalance trade.

zh.title: 中国8月份进口表现不佳，出口加速增长，贸易再平衡呼声高涨
zh.summary: 中国8月份出口和进口活动加速，为全球第二大经济体释放出经济动力信号。然而，进口额低于分析师预期，凸显持续存在的贸易失衡问题。数据反映了国际社会持续推动中国贸易关系再平衡的压力。

title: Nvidia supplier Wistron's shares drop after it announces $1.5 billion global stock sale
summary: Wistron, a key Nvidia supplier, announced a $1.5 billion global share sale, prompting a sharp decline in stock price. The capital raise triggered immediate market selling pressure as investors reacted to shareholder dilution. The move suggests the company is seeking funds for expansion or operational needs.
content: Wistron shares fall Tuesday after announcement of $1.5 billion global share sale

zh.title: 英伟达供应商纬创宣布发行15亿美元全球股票后股价下跌
zh.summary: 作为英伟达的关键供应商，纬创宣布发行15亿美元全球股票，引发股价急剧下跌。此次融资引发了市场立即抛售压力，投资者对股权稀释作出反应。此举表明该公司正在寻求资金用于扩张或运营需求。

title: Dow futures fall 300 points to start shortened week as oil prices climb: Live updates
summary: Dow futures fell 300 points as trading opened for a holiday-shortened week, with investors monitoring rising oil prices and escalating Canada-U.S. trade tensions. Middle East geopolitical risks continued to weigh on market sentiment. Energy costs and international trade disputes are key drivers of market movement this week.
content: Dow futures fell to kick off a shortened week of trading, with Wall Street keeping tabs on the Middle East war as well as rising trade tensions between Canada and the U.S.

zh.title: 油价上升之际，道指期货下跌300点，开启缩短的交易周：实时更新
zh.summary: 随着交易在假期缩短的一周开始，道指期货下跌300点，投资者密切关注油价上升和加美贸易紧张局势升级。中东地缘政治风险继续对市场情绪造成压力。能源成本和国际贸易争端是本周市场走势的关键推动因素。

title: Bombardier points out U.S. footprint after Trump says aerospace giant must build in America
summary: President Trump called on Bombardier, a major Canadian aerospace manufacturer, to shift production to the United States, prompting the company to highlight its existing American operations. The statement coincides with Canada's planned retaliatory tariffs of $20 billion on U.S. goods taking effect. The exchange reflects escalating trade tensions between the neighboring countries.
content: Trump's announcement comes on the eve of Canadian retaliatory tariffs set to take effect Tuesday on $20 billion of U.S. goods.

zh.title: 特朗普称航空航天巨头必须在美国建厂后，庞巴迪指出其美国足迹
zh.summary: 特朗普总统呼吁加拿大主要航空航天制造商庞巴迪将生产转移到美国，促使该公司强调其现有的美国业务。此声明恰逢加拿大计划对美国商品征收200亿美元报复性关税生效。这一交流反映了邻国之间日益升级的贸易紧张局势。

title: Iran foreign ministry takes aim at Canada for support of U.S. actions in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iran's foreign ministry criticized Canada for supporting U.S. actions in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's regional activities. Canada had previously condemned Iran's destabilizing Middle East actions and pledged to maintain international pressure. The dispute underscores broader geopolitical tensions over regional security and diplomatic alignment.
content: Canada had condemned Iran’s "destabilizing actions" in the Middle East, saying that it would work with partners to maintain significant pressure on Iran.

zh.title: 伊朗外交部因加拿大支持美国在霍尔木兹海峡的行动而批评加拿大
zh.summary: 伊朗外交部批评加拿大支持美国在霍尔木兹海峡的行动和伊朗的地区活动。加拿大先前谴责了伊朗在中东的破坏稳定行动，并承诺维持国际压力。这一争端凸显了关于地区安全和外交协调的更广泛地缘政治紧张局势。

title: Oil extends gains as renewed Mideast hostilities raise worries of prolonged conflict
summary: Oil prices extended gains Tuesday as escalating Middle East hostilities between the U.S. and Iran sparked supply disruption concerns. Traders fear the conflict could persist and threaten crude exports from the strategically critical region. Heightened geopolitical risk is driving increased oil demand as markets price in conflict-related supply constraints.
content: Oil prices rose Tuesday on worries over escalating Mideast tensions after the U.S. and Iran traded strikes over the weekend.

zh.title: 随着中东敌对行动升级引发对长期冲突的担忧，石油价格继续上升
zh.summary: 周二，美国与伊朗之间的中东敌对行动升级引发供应中断担忧，油价继续上升。交易员担心冲突可能持续并威胁来自战略要地的原油出口。地缘政治风险升高正在推高石油需求，因为市场计入了冲突相关的供应约束。

title: Trump threatens to stop sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in US
summary: President Trump threatened to stop Bombardier aircraft sales in the United States as part of an intensifying trade dispute with Canada. The threat targets one of Canada's largest employers and industrial exporters. The escalation marks a deepening of bilateral trade tensions between the neighboring countries.
content: The threat against one of Canada's largest companies comes amid an escalating trade war between the two neighbours.

zh.title: 特朗普威胁停止加拿大庞巴迪飞机在美国的销售
zh.summary: 特朗普总统威胁停止加拿大庞巴迪飞机在美国的销售，作为与加拿大贸易争端不断升级的一部分。该威胁针对加拿大最大的雇主和工业出口商之一。升级标志着两个邻国之间双边贸易紧张关系的加深。
